Class Multimaps

java.lang.Object
be.imgn.gaia.core.collect.Multimaps
public final class Multimaps extends Object
Static factories and collectors for unmodifiable multimaps that iterate over their keys in the order they first appear, and over the values of a key in the order they are given.

They behave like the maps of Maps:

  • They are unmodifiable: every mutator method throws UnsupportedOperationException, even when the call would not change the multimap. That includes the methods of their views and their iterators.
  • They reject null keys and values, and querying them with null, as in containsKey(null), throws NullPointerException.
  • They are serializable if all their keys and values are.
  • They are value-based: do not rely on their identity.
  • equals and hashCode follow the Multimap contract, so a list multimap from this class equals any list multimap with the same keys and values in the same order, whatever the order of its keys.
Since:
0.1.2
